name: London
limitations: Conditional centre60 after the actual disease-specific CAR-T pathway challenges the earlier limited ageing-pathway basis for LON40. Other seven judgments and their counterevidence are unchanged. Current local delivery, eligibility, payment, affordable practical access and safe monitoring require reversible assumptions. LON40 remains a supported sensitivity alternative; withdrawing LON gives54–64 with no centre. No global ranking or exclusion qualification.

dimensions.rationale: Operational tidal defences and low reference seismic hazard support protection; heat-associated mortality, surface-water risk and historical facility failures remain material constraints.
dimensions.assumption: Major protection usually functions in 2026; unresolved groups and hazards do not already create a stronger widespread unmitigated constraint.

dimensions.rationale: Actual CTP April29 response, injury care and suspect arrest plus Met April28 delivered protective advice/support to local organisations complement the May1 national assessment. Recurring attacks and targeted-community constraints remain; the national level is not a city rate.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped ordinarily limited impact, observed local response/protective support and current applicability of state-linked/target-site scenarios. Neither complete prevention nor foreign attribution of each case is inferred. Material remaining community/channel constraint40; stronger low-impact coverage and effective redundancy80; rejecting scope/impact/continuation restores unknown,51–66 without centre.

dimensions.rationale: Public accountability, delivered service changes and actual fire response support execution; group differences and unmeasured recovery tails limit stronger claims.
dimensions.assumption: Observed execution persists and unreviewed services do not have broad delivery failures; community experience differences are not assumed away.

dimensions.rationale: Operational water supply, domestic and traded food and observed electricity restoration support usual provision; bills, water performance and common dependencies remain constraints.
dimensions.assumption: Essentials remain usually available and affordable for median-income residents; operator and national evidence do not measure the whole FUA.

dimensions.rationale: Residence-based provision, delivered treatment, actual ambulance response and one hospital inspection support care pathways; elective and cancer waits remain important limitations.
dimensions.assumption: Necessary treatment is usually usable through public pathways; waiting has not broadly become an unmitigated blockage. Hospital inspection is not a city-wide adjusted outcome.

dimensions.rationale: Actual London CAR-T treatment, NICE human-outcome appraisal, ordinarily resident NHS commissioning and local monitoring connect a disease-limited translation pathway. Manufacturing, referral/apheresis capacity, carer/travel requirements and lifelong malignancy monitoring remain substantive constraints. Earlier general-ageing studies do not represent the whole dimension.
dimensions.assumption: Existing local delivery and commissioned NHS pathways persist to the cutoff and usually remain usable by clinically eligible ordinary median-income residents. This does not assume every resident qualifies, all indirect costs are covered, or all referred patients reach infusion. Residual waits, care requirements and safety-information defects are material but do not usually break the reviewed pathway; rejecting a necessary continuity/access assumption restores null.

dimensions.rationale: Actual research-derived commercialisation and delivered digital support establish capability alongside local hearing evidence of connection, upgrade and affordability constraints. Delivered mitigation is retained; forecast support totals and older UK-wide SME rates are not current London measurements.
dimensions.assumption: Reviewed capacities and local constraints persist to the cutoff and reasonably apply to ordinary median-income residents and the FUA. The observed connection/diffusion bottlenecks remain material after delivered mitigation; their 2026 residual incidence is not measured. This is a provisional representativeness judgment, not a cap based on unknown higher-tier evidence. Rejecting these necessary assumptions restores unknown TEC; broader actual output/use and effective mitigation could support 80.

dimensions.rationale: Delivered aviation and a specific British-citizen residence/work route to Ireland coexist with particular pension-transfer conditions, a documented airport electricity failure and unresolved communication redundancy.
dimensions.assumption: Ordinary residents have usable travel funds, accounts and alternative communication; household eligibility, relocation costs and independent substitutes remain unverified.
